_note: MuSiQue variant of configs/decomposer.json for issue #12 (guided vs unguided decomposition). Same runner, same model folder, same seed, same retrieval input for all three conditions - only 'conditions' differs, so the comparison isolates the hop-count signal. hops [2,3,4] and the MuSiQue question files replace MetaQA's [1,2,3]; the MetaQA defaults are untouched. The decomposer model is chosen with --model (its parameter count is asserted against configs/model_limits.json at load, as on every path), and the condition with --condition.

conditions._note: The three arms of issue #12. 'guided' decides whether the gold hop count is injected into the prompt (and therefore whether the model's guided or unguided prompt file is used); 'step_cap' decides whether the step-line cap below applies. Selected with --condition; the runner refuses --guided against a guided=false condition, so an arm cannot be silently mislabelled. IMPORTANT: the two unguided arms need a model folder that HAS an unguided_prompt_file (mistral_7b_instruct, qwen3_5_9b as of 2026-08-18). Without one the runner falls back to the guided prompt with hop_count='Unknown', which still puts a hop-count line in front of the model; it warns and records unguided_prompt_missing when that happens.

step_cap._note: Applies only to conditions with step_cap=true. max_step_lines stops generation once that many step lines are complete, and the decoded text is truncated to the same number (a step line is a non-blank line, the same rule the evaluator scores with - src/step_cap.py). max_new_tokens is the token half of the cap: null means keep the model config's own max_new_tokens, which holds decoding identical across the three conditions; an integer here tightens it for the capped arm only. Jahid's supervisor confirmed a length cap is not cheating.

retrieval._note: input_key names a configs/paths.json datasets key rather than a literal path, so the smoke paths config can redirect it to fixtures and no machine path is baked into a config. The artifact is the ADR 0007 evaluation set (600 questions, 200 per hop depth) put through bi-encoder top-20 then cross-encoder rerank to top-5; 'typed' selects the typed-masked neighbour list. hop_fallback never fires on this set: all 600 ids start with <n>hop, so the gold hop count comes from the id.
